title: Swan Lake
description: A swan takes in a quiet moment in the busy transit waters of Lake Balaton in Szántód, Hungary. The Tihany ferry crosses the lake between Tihanyrév and Szántódrév multiple times a day. Lake Balaton is the largest freshwater lake in central Europe, where several different species—including mute swans—call home.
translated_description: 在匈牙利桑托德，一只天鹅在巴拉顿湖繁忙的航运水域中享受片刻宁静。蒂豪尼渡轮每天多次往返于蒂豪尼港和桑托德港之间，横渡湖面。巴拉顿湖是中欧最大的淡水湖，这里栖息着多种不同的物种，其中包括疣鼻天鹅。
